data.one_liner: Minimalistic TCP tunnel library and CLI written in Dart
data.what_it_does: Provides a TCP tunneling library and CLI tool supporting local port redirects, bridge tunneling, client tunnels, and hub mode routing between networks behind NAT.
use_when: You need to expose private servers or services behind NAT to other networks
You want a pure Dart TCP tunneling library with a CLI tool
avoid_when: You require application-level protocols or HTTP-specific routing without relying on raw TCP pipes
strengths: Entirely written in Dart with a convenient CLI
Supports multiple tunnel types including local redirect, bridge, client, and hub mode
Opt-in TLS encryption and token authentication for hub mode
weaknesses: Plaintext and unauthenticated by default in legacy local, bridge, and client modes
